title: Turn a spatial question into an editable Earthly map
post: A useful AI map shouldn't end as a screenshot. Here Earthly researches nearby drinking-water points, turns them into editable geometry, and keeps the proposed change behind a human approval step.
videoAltText: A desktop recording of Earthly's AI chat creating drinking-water points and walking catchments, followed by a tour of the editable geometry and map.

prompts.text: Find the nearest public drinking-water point to each of these Vienna trailheads: Kahlenberg (48.2767, 16.3339) and Lainzer Tor (48.1775, 16.2574). Add both water points and a 15-minute walking catchment around each one. Keep useful source metadata, make the result editable, and show every proposed map change before applying it.
